capabilities: Replace a configurable keyword in the current file with tasks pulled from a Todoist filter
Complete or reopen the Todoist task behind a checklist item via a toggle command
Toggle non-Todoist checklist items locally when they lack a Todoist URL
Map multiple keywords to separate Todoist filter definitions
Exclude folders so template files keep their keyword unreplaced
extras: README warns that the Todoist API token is stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins and should not be synced or shared; the plugin does not support adding tasks to Todoist or pulling remote changes into files.
problem: Obsidian checklist items are purely local, so there is no way to complete tasks that live in Todoist directly from a note.

relations.evidence: This obsidian plugin integrates your Todoist tasks with markdown checkboxes in a text-centric approach.

requires.name: Todoist desktop app (recommended for adding tasks)

summary: Todoist integration that pulls tasks into notes as Markdown checkboxes and syncs checking them off with Todoist.
